podcast.title: Blues Legend
podcast.body: Tampa Red, featured in Tampa Red's Hocum Drug Band, later became a significant blues legend in his own right. "This group featured Tampa Red, who would later go on to be a blues legend in his own right..."

srcs.source: A History of Rock Music in 500 Songs

podcast.title: Influence on Young James Brown
podcast.body: Although young James Brown was not interested in the blues his father played, he learned from blues legend Tampa Red when Red dated one of the sex workers at Brown's aunt's house. This indicates Brown's eagerness to learn music from any available source, even from a genre he generally disliked. "But even there, when Tampa Red started dating one of the sex workers who worked with his aunt's house, Young James Brown learned what he could from the blues legend."

srcs.source: A History of Rock Music in 500 Songs
